1 (Currently amended): A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher; placing the cement composition in a subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 3 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed under wellbore conditions.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin processed from chicory.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 6 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

9 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

10 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.
